sources.role: Official confirmation that Welch lacks developed public access and has limited parking; recommends considering an outfitter and identifies County Road 7 bridge drop-off context.
Official confirmation that Welch has no formal public water access, that local outfitters serve paddlers, and that the Highway 61 landing is used by paddlers finishing from Welch.
Confirms service model: trips start at the mill, shuttle customers upstream, return to the mill, and recommend reservations; lists address 26389 County 7 Blvd.
Secondary coordinate cross-check for the Welch Mill shop/business pin; not evidence of public landing rights or a surveyed water-entry point.
